source_review: cleanup_verified_scratch.py is byte-identical to its previously independently reviewed version, retaining allocated_bytes in every strict identity comparison.
The wrapper fsyncs all copied files, metadata indexes, status, selected sealed roots and the fresh sibling seal before cleanup/archive_index captures identities.
All directory links are fsynced from deepest directory through repository root. No archive bytes are rewritten.
File fsync opens read-only with O_NOFOLLOW and O_NONBLOCK after lstat regular-file check; device/inode and type are rechecked after opening.
Any file or directory fsync exception propagates before cleanup is invoked. The completed flush record is durable before cleanup starts.
Existing archive_generation_gate.py remains unchanged; gate/log/source verification is preserved.

resolved_review_points.issue: A FIFO could block before fstat rejected its type.
resolved_review_points.resolution: Added pre-open lstat regular-file rejection and O_NONBLOCK, independently tested without any open.

resolved_review_points.issue: Fresh-message sibling seal was outside selected archive-root enumeration.
resolved_review_points.resolution: Explicitly fsync fresh-retained-hashes.json before cleanup identity capture, covered by producer and independent ordering checks.

limits: Review performed no live fsync, cleanup, build, decoder, benchmark or profiling operation; only disposable /tmp fixtures were used.
Quiescence remains an explicit caller precondition; this change does not introduce process detection or weaken exact identity checks.
A previously archived gate can use a separately retained read-only-fsync step and a new direct-cleanup receipt; this review did not execute that procedure.
